title: Shadowed Mirror Selfie
description: A man with dark hair and beard holds a black smartphone in his right hand, partially obscuring the right side of his face as he takes a selfie. The composition is framed as a small, brightly lit rectangular image centered within a vast, textured black void.
prompt: A man with dark hair, beard and serious expression holds a black smartphone in his right hand while taking a selfie, the phone partially covering the right side of his face, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting with strong highlights on his face and hand against deep shadows, the entire scene appears as a small rectangular image floating in the center of a vast textured black background, moody and atmospheric, realistic digital painting style
